Vindictus: Defying Fate - Official ‘Let the Righteous Judge’ Cinematic Trailer
recentItems.description: Take a look at the ‘Let the Righteous Judge’ Cinematic Trailer for Vindictus: Defying Fate, a dark fantasy medieval action RPG developed by Nexon. Players can get a cinematic look at the narrative implications of the dramatic world of Vindictus: Defying Fate. Vindictus: Defying Fate is launching on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Echofall - Official Gameplay Trailer
recentItems.description: Check out gameplay from Echofall in this trailer for the upcoming sci-fi FPS power fantasy where the rules of reality become yours to break. Bend gravity, chain impossible movement and turn the world itself against your enemies as you descend into a beautiful nightmare. Echofall will be available on PC via Steam. If you're interested, you can wishlist it on Steam or request access to join the Playtest here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805770/Echofall/

Attack on Titan 3 - Official 'Character Interactions & Expeditions Beyond the Walls' Gameplay
recentItems.description: Get a look at the 'Character Interactions & Expeditions Beyond the Walls' Gameplay for Attack on Titan 3, an anime action game based on the beloved anime series developed by Koei Tecmo Games. Players can get an extensive look at the moment-to-moment gameplay for the game, featuring character dialogue and combat against fearsome Titans. Attack on Titan 3 is launching on December 10 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Wilderdark - Official Launch Trailer
recentItems.description: Watch the Launch Trailer for Wilderdark, a first-person survival horror action-adventure game developed by Team Junkfish. Players will explore an elusive island to quietly secure evidence, obtain samples, and craft items to survive the dinosaurs and otherworldly organisms alike. Wilderdark is available now on PC (Steam).

recentItems.title: Wolfenstein 3 Is Officially in Development - IGN Daily Fix
recentItems.description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has announced a new Wolfenstein game is in development at MachineGames. The studio is also behind the most recent entries in the rebooted Wolfenstein series and 2024's excellent Indiana Jones and the Great Circle. In other news, The PS4—yes, the PlayStation 4—is getting a new God of War game: the side-scrolling action game Sons of Sparta. The game originally dropped for the SP5 earlier this year, and is also getting two new modes. And finally, in an announcement appropriate for today's date, a new Friday the 13th movie has been announced, to be released next year.

#IGN #Gaming

recentItems.title: Nightcrawler (Strategist) Full Match Gameplay | Marvel Rivals
recentItems.description:
BAMF! Nightcrawler joins the fight in **Marvel Rivals**, bringing his incredible teleportation abilities and three-sword fighting style to the battlefield. Also known as Kurt Wagner, the X-Men hero uses his supernatural agility and ability to teleport to outmaneuver opponents and strike when they least expect it.

Watch a full match of Nightcrawler gameplay in Marvel Rivals, showcasing his abilities, including Three-Sword Style, Swift Intervention, Smoke Shift, Tandem Teleport, Crawler Cling, and his ultimate ability, Phasing Finale. See how the fuzzy elf brings his unique teleportation skills and swordsmanship into the battle!

recentItems.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time - How to Learn the Secret Scarecrow Song
recentItems.description:
The Scarecrow Song is a necessary song to learn for 100% completion in The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, allowing you to spawn a Scarecrow as a target for the hookshot, leading to hidden areas and secret collectibles. In this quick video guide, we’ll show you exactly how to learn the Scarecrow Song!
